name: ClipGrab
description: ClipGrab compares the retrieved installer’s SHA1 digest with the SHA1 value supplied in its XML update manifest before proceeding with installation; the manifest transport and trust root are not independently authenticated in this source review.
limitations: The cited implementation is from the extracted official 3.9.14 source archive; this is archive evidence rather than a pinned Git checkout, and it does not authenticate the XML manifest or establish the original study release context.
project_link_basis: Recorded repository in original batch report; not a new upstream verification.
